# pve_sdn_zone_qinq (Resource)

Manages a QinQ SDN zone (`/cluster/sdn/zones`, type `qinq`) stacking the vnets' inner VLAN tags below a service-VLAN tag on the zone. Creating, updating, or deleting a zone only changes the pending SDN configuration; run the `pve_sdn_apply` action to apply it to the running configuration. Changing `zone` forces recreation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Manage a QinQ SDN zone with a service-VLAN tag.
resource "pve_sdn_zone_qinq" "zone1" {
  zone          = "zone1"
  bridge        = "vmbr0"
  tag           = 100
  vlan_protocol = "802.1ad"

  nodes = "pve1,pve2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The SDN zone object identifier (2 to 8 characters, starting with a letter). Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `bridge` (String) The local bridge (PVE `bridge`) on each node where the service VLAN for this zone is managed, for example `vmbr0`.
- `dhcp` (String) Name of the DHCP server backend for this zone (PVE `dhcp`). Must be one of: `dnsmasq`.
- `dns` (String) ID of the DNS API server (PVE `dns`) for this zone.
- `dnszone` (String) DNS domain zone for this zone (PVE `dnszone`), for example `mydomain.com`.
- `ipam` (String) ID of the IPAM (PVE `ipam`) managing IP addresses in this zone, for example `pve`.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the zone (PVE `mtu`), used for the created VNet bridges.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names where this zone should be created (PVE `pve-node-list`), for example `pve1,pve2`.
- `reversedns` (String) ID of the reverse DNS server (PVE `reversedns`) for this zone.
- `tag` (Number) Service-VLAN tag, i.e. the outer VLAN id of the QinQ zone (PVE `tag`). Must be 0 or greater.
- `vlan_protocol` (String) VLAN protocol used when creating the QinQ zone (PVE `vlan-protocol`, default `802.1q`). Must be one of: `802.1q`, `802.1ad`.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) The read-only SDN configuration revision (PVE `digest`) of the zone section.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Import a PVE SDN zone by its zone identifier.
terraform import pve_sdn_zone_qinq.zone1 "zone1"
```
